name: io.github.psdgator/multi-gmail-account-mcp
title: Multi Gmail Account MCP
description: Many Gmail and IMAP accounts at once: unified search, needs-reply, digest, attachments, Calendar, drafts-only by default.

packageArguments.name: --mode
packageArguments.description: readonly, drafts (default: never sends) or full

environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_MCP_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Folder for config, encrypted logins and the audit log (default ~/.gmail-mcp)
